requiredState: current setup completion version is durably persisted
language and current area are preserved
the user is not already authoritatively authenticated
a protected destination intent is retained when sign-in was action-triggered

states.rule: Only a qualified provider may open its provider-owned surface. An unavailable provider remains truthful and cannot dispatch a gateway call. MoolSocial never reproduces provider credentials or consent.

states.validation: Normalize and validate the email locally before requesting a link; never place the raw email address in a review URL.

rules: mask the destination email in visible confirmation
do not claim authentication until Firebase completes the link
allow a different email or another method

outcomes: different-device confirmation using the same email

states.rule: Preserve the independently qualified Firebase Phone Authentication journey and operating-system one-time-code autofill behavior; never read the SMS inbox silently.

states.result: merge setup into the authenticated account and open the exact pending protected destination, or Universal when no valid pending destination exists

providerRules.youtube: Use Google basic identity only. Request YouTube channel scopes later and only from creator tools with feature-specific consent.
providerRules.availability: Visible provider presentation does not prove live readiness. Dispatch is enabled only when the exact provider is qualified for the current platform and environment.
security: no raw provider credentials collected by MoolSocial UI

routing.emailLinkReturn: /sign-in with a validated Firebase email-link return
routing.authenticatedExit: exact captured /app/ protected destination when valid; otherwise /app/social
routing.interruptionRule: Process death or relaunch during incomplete authentication returns to a truthful recoverable sign-in state without claiming authentication.

prohibited: mixing legacy SignInScreen or VerifyOtpScreen into UI V2
numeric Email OTP presentation or backend fallback
internal implementation, example, review or test language in customer copy
dropping Screen 02 area or pending-destination state during authentication
